# Svecicezaauto — Complete Auto Ignition Parts Reference

> Full reference documentation for AI ingestion. This file contains all essential information about the svecicezaauto.rs auto parts catalog in a single document.

---

# About Svecicezaauto

Svecicezaauto is an online store specializing in automotive ignition system parts, headquartered in Belgrade, Serbia. The business serves the Serbian and Russian-speaking markets with a catalog of over 20,000 individual parts.

**Key Facts:**
- Website: https://svecicezaauto.rs
- Languages: Serbian (default), Russian (/ru/ prefix)
- Contact: Viber/WhatsApp +381 66 504 0583
- Pricing: Available on request (not displayed on website)
- Payment: Cash on delivery (pouzeće) via courier
- Delivery: Courier services (BEX, AKS, Post Express) across Serbia
- Personal delivery available in Belgrade for orders over 25,000 RSD

---

# Product Categories

The catalog is organized into 8 ignition system categories:

## 1. Spark Plugs (Svećice)
- **URL**: /kategorija/svecice
- **Russian**: Свечи зажигания
- **Description**: Spark plugs and glow plugs for petrol and diesel engines across all vehicle makes and models.

## 2. Ignition Coils — Bobina (Kalem za paljenje)
- **URL**: /kategorija/kalem-za-paljenje-bobina
- **Russian**: Катушка зажигания
- **Description**: Individual coils, coil packs, and coil-on-plug units for modern and classic ignition systems.

## 3. Control Units (Kontrolna jedinica)
- **URL**: /kategorija/kontrolna-jedinica
- **Russian**: Блок управления
- **Description**: Electronic ignition control units (ICU/ECU) for various vehicle platforms.

## 4. Ignition Distributors (Razvodnik paljenja)
- **URL**: /kategorija/razvodnik-paljenja
- **Russian**: Распределитель зажигания
- **Description**: Complete distributor assemblies, caps, rotors for mechanical and electronic ignition systems.

## 5. Ignition Modules (Modul paljenja)
- **URL**: /kategorija/modul-paljenja
- **Russian**: Модуль зажигания
- **Description**: Ignition amplifier and switching modules.

## 6. Ignition Cables (Kablovi za paljenje)
- **URL**: /kategorija/kablovi-za-paljenje-delovi
- **Russian**: Высоковольтные провода
- **Description**: High-voltage ignition wire sets, individual cables, and connector components.

## 7. Distributor Drives (Pogon razvodnika paljenja)
- **URL**: /kategorija/pogon-razvodnika-paljenja
- **Russian**: Привод распределителя
- **Description**: Distributor drive gears, shafts, and coupling components.

## 8. Resistors (Otpornik)
- **URL**: /kategorija/otpornik
- **Russian**: Резистор
- **Description**: Ballast resistors for ignition systems.

---

# How to Find Parts

## By Part Number (OEM Number)
The most reliable way to find a part is by its OEM part number. Use the search functionality:
- **Search page**: https://svecicezaauto.rs/search
- **Search index (JSON)**: https://svecicezaauto.rs/search-index.json

The search index contains all 20,000+ parts in JSON format with fields:
- `id`: Unique product identifier
- `part_number`: OEM/manufacturer part number
- `category`: Product category slug

## By Category
Browse all products within a category at `/kategorija/{category-slug}`.
Pages are paginated. Available category slugs:
- `svecice`
- `kalem-za-paljenje-bobina`
- `kontrolna-jedinica`
- `razvodnik-paljenja`
- `modul-paljenja`
- `kablovi-za-paljenje-delovi`
- `pogon-razvodnika-paljenja`
- `otpornik`

## By Vehicle
Each product page at `/proizvod/{id}` includes a vehicle compatibility table showing:
- Vehicle make (e.g., BMW, Audi, Volkswagen)
- Vehicle models (e.g., Golf IV, Passat B5)
- Engine range/type
- Year range (from–to)

**Important**: Vehicle compatibility data is informational and may not be complete. Contact the store to confirm fitment for your specific vehicle.

---

# URL Structure

| Page Type | Serbian URL | Russian URL |
|---|---|---|
| Homepage | `/` | `/ru/` |
| Category | `/kategorija/{slug}` | `/ru/kategorija/{slug}` |
| Product | `/proizvod/{id}` | `/ru/proizvod/{id}` |
| Search | `/search` | `/ru/search` |
| Delivery Info | `/dostava` | `/ru/dostava` |
| Contact | `/kontakt` | `/ru/kontakt` |

# Delivery Information

## Courier Delivery (All of Serbia)
- All orders are shipped via courier services across Serbia
- Payment method: Cash on delivery (pouzeće) — pay the courier when you receive the package
- Shipping costs are borne by the buyer according to the courier's current price list

## Personal Delivery (Belgrade Only)
- Available for orders over 25,000 RSD (amount subject to negotiation)
- Arranged directly via Viber or WhatsApp during the ordering process

For the fastest response, send the **part number (OEM number)** and your **vehicle model** in the message.

# Technical Information

- **Platform**: Static site built with Astro
- **Hosting**: GitHub Pages
- **Domain**: svecicezaauto.rs
- **Search**: Client-side search using JSON index
- **Authentication**: None required (fully public)
- **API**: Static JSON search index at /search-index.json
- **Sitemap**: /sitemap-index.xml
- **Structured Data**: Schema.org Product markup on product pages
